harbour-dawn.prompt:
A quiet harbour at first light, seen from the waterfront; moored sailing boats on calm water and a low sun rising over the far shore

Style: Editorial photography with soft, natural light and a calm, optimistic mood. Muted, slightly desaturated tones and clean compositions with generous negative space. Real places and people; never illustration, 3D renders or stock-photo poses.

Brand colours: where it suits the scene, lean on #12182B (ink), #3B82F6 (accent), #8B5CF6 (accent2), #0EA5E9 (accent3).

Format: a portrait (2:3) image for a presentation slide. No text, lettering, captions, logos or watermarks.
